name: icons_spells
prompt: A sheet of EXACTLY 6 original spell icons for a fantasy game, arranged in a grid of 3 columns and 2 rows. Top row, left to right: a single straight piercing beam of white-violet light shooting diagonally from a small glowing magic circle, thin and precise; a volley of five small glowing teal-blue mana bolts curving forward together in a fan; a translucent pale-blue dome-shaped magic barrier made of hexagonal light panels. Bottom row, left to right: many golden-white light rays raining down from a large glowing magic circle in the sky, the ultimate spell; a small violet flame half hidden behind a soft drifting veil of mist, calm and secret; a single small round teal-blue mana orb with a short bright trail. Style: hand-painted fantasy RPG game icons in a soft cel-shaded anime game style, bold clean readable silhouettes that stay readable at 48 pixels, a few large shapes, thin dark brown-violet ink outlines, warm palette of ivory, warm gold and parchment with amethyst violet and teal-blue mana accents, soft afternoon light from the top left. Each icon is a single object only: NO frame, NO border, NO background plate, NO circle behind it, NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO labels, NO captions. Plain flat uniform light grey background everywhere (#c9c9c9), no shadows on the background, no gradients in the background. Icons laid out on a strict regular grid, each centered in its own equal cell, all the same size, with wide empty grey space between icons so they never touch or overlap.
